reviews.text: The staff are very knowledgeable and helpful and absolutely loved my puppy and gave me helpful tips

I wanted to thank Hazel publicly for her excellent customer service yesterday. I went into store with my dog for a harness fitting. The selection of harnesses was vast and her professionalism and patience was remarkable. I’m very indecisive, and my dog is not a fan of a harness but she made both of our experience much easier, and I didn’t feel rushed or forced into making a decision. There was also a theft in store whilst I was visiting, she remained calm and professional and made a conscious effort to reassure me and my 10 year old daughter. She is an asset to your store and I hope she receives the recognition that she deserves!

Highly recommend, I came in a few weeks ago. Hazel,  was so friendly and helpful, went out of her way to help me when she noticed I was struggling, she helped me find products suitable for my animal and gave me so much information! Lovely staff member who needs recognition for her hard work!

**REVIEW OF CAR PARK **
Absolutely ridiculous parking enforcement from UKPS! I briefly entered the nearby building for a few minutes and was slapped with a parking fine. There were no clear signs warning about this, and it feels like nothing more than a money-making scheme. Instead of providing fair parking solutions, they seem more interested in penalising people unfairly. Avoid this place if you don’t want to be hit with an unexpected fine!

I went to Just For Pets Northfield, to discuss the pros and cons of changing my dog's food from dry to raw. The customer service that I received from Hazel, was excellent. Her knowledge of the subject and the instructions that she wrote out for me, made the whole process of transitioning to raw food very clear and easy.
I have visited this store on several occasions for various items and highly recommend it to anyone seeking first rate service.
